wins: Reached the web application perimeter and completed initial reconnaissance, including OS detection and service enumeration, yielding a 47.5 reward even without overall success.
Leveraged mentor guidance efficiently with 15 calls to stay aligned with objectives, ensuring no wasted steps in navigation or host discovery.
fails: Failed to achieve a successful compromise within the single episode, ending with a 0% success rate despite thorough reconnaissance.
Privilege escalation stage repeatedly stalled due to missing or unsuitable exploit modules, which prevented mission completion.
key_outcomes.summary: Run prioritized reconnaissance effectively but could not progress past privilege escalation; focus next experiments on improving exploit coverage and automation of escalation steps.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts consistently halted because appropriate exploits or sudo misconfigurations were not identified before attack execution.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts to identify valid usernames and potential weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80/443 returns HTML with application fingerprint signatures
skill_cards.then_action: Execute automated directory brute-force and CMS fingerprinting to map attack surface

skill_cards.if_condition: When local user enumeration completes without privilege escalation success
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to kernel exploit enumeration, checking known CVEs matched to kernel version

memory_ops.reason: Successful SSH enumeration pattern produced actionable data for downstream attack planning.

next_experiments.title: Automated privilege escalation mapping
next_experiments.description: Integrate automated mapping of sudo permissions plus kernel CVE lookup for detected versions before executing escalation attempts.

next_experiments.title: Exploit module diversification
next_experiments.description: Expand post-recon toolchain to include multiple exploit frameworks (Metasploit, custom scripts) to increase chance of successful escalation.

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse verification
next_experiments.description: After successful SSH enumeration, systematically test found usernames across additional services (SMB, MySQL) to harvest lateral movement avenues.
